rawToolsCapture.name: aggregate-db
rawToolsCapture.description: Run an aggregation against a MongoDB database

rawToolsCapture.name: aggregate
rawToolsCapture.description: Run an aggregation against a MongoDB collection

rawToolsCapture.name: collection-indexes
rawToolsCapture.description: Describe the indexes for a collection

rawToolsCapture.name: collection-schema
rawToolsCapture.description: Describe the schema for a collection

rawToolsCapture.name: collection-storage-size
rawToolsCapture.description: Gets the size of the collection

rawToolsCapture.name: connect
rawToolsCapture.description: Connect to a MongoDB instance and get back a connectionId to pass to the other MongoDB tools. Each call establishes a new, independent connection — multiple connections can be active at the same time.

rawToolsCapture.name: count
rawToolsCapture.description: Gets the number of documents in a MongoDB collection using db.collection.count() and query as an optional filter parameter

rawToolsCapture.name: create-collection
rawToolsCapture.description: Creates a new collection in a database. If the database doesn't exist, it will be created automatically.

rawToolsCapture.name: create-index
rawToolsCapture.description: Create an index for a collection

rawToolsCapture.name: db-stats
rawToolsCapture.description: Returns statistics that reflect the use state of a single database

rawToolsCapture.name: delete-many
rawToolsCapture.description: Removes all documents that match the filter from a MongoDB collection

rawToolsCapture.name: disconnect
rawToolsCapture.description: Close a MongoDB connection and revoke its connectionId.

rawToolsCapture.name: drop-collection
rawToolsCapture.description: Removes a collection or view from the database. The method also removes any indexes associated with the dropped collection.

rawToolsCapture.name: drop-database
rawToolsCapture.description: Removes the specified database, deleting the associated data files

rawToolsCapture.name: drop-index
rawToolsCapture.description: Drop an index for the provided database and collection.

rawToolsCapture.name: explain
rawToolsCapture.description: Returns statistics describing the execution of the winning plan chosen by the query optimizer for the evaluated method

rawToolsCapture.name: export
rawToolsCapture.description: Export a query or aggregation results in the specified EJSON format.

rawToolsCapture.name: find
rawToolsCapture.description: Run a find query against a MongoDB collection

rawToolsCapture.name: insert-many
rawToolsCapture.description: Insert an array of documents into a MongoDB collection. If the list of documents is above com.mongodb/maxRequestPayloadBytes, consider inserting them in batches.

rawToolsCapture.name: list-collections
rawToolsCapture.description: List all collections for a given database

rawToolsCapture.name: list-connections
rawToolsCapture.description: List the active MongoDB connections and their connectionIds. Use this to find a connectionId established earlier.

rawToolsCapture.name: list-databases
rawToolsCapture.description: List all databases for a MongoDB connection

rawToolsCapture.name: mongodb-logs
rawToolsCapture.description: Returns the most recent logged mongod events

rawToolsCapture.name: rename-collection
rawToolsCapture.description: Renames a collection in a MongoDB database

rawToolsCapture.name: update-many
rawToolsCapture.description: Updates all documents that match the specified filter for a collection. If the list of documents is above com.mongodb/maxRequestPayloadBytes, consider updating them in batches.

rawToolsCapture.name: list-knowledge-sources
rawToolsCapture.description: List available data sources in the MongoDB Assistant knowledge base. Use this to explore available data sources or to find search filter parameters to use in search-knowledge.

rawToolsCapture.name: search-knowledge
rawToolsCapture.description: Search for information in the MongoDB Assistant knowledge base. This includes official documentation, curated expert guidance, and other resources provided by MongoDB. Supports filtering by data source and version.
